title: A flaw in Node.js `crypto` causes the internal entropy caches used by `crypto.randomUUID()`, `crypto.randomUUIDv7()`,…
description: A vulnerability exists in Node.js version 3.0 related to the internal entropy caches used by the crypto module's randomUUID() and randomUUIDv7() functions. This flaw involves improper handling of entropy, which may affect the randomness quality of UUID generation. No CVSS score or detailed impact information is provided. No patch or remediation details are available at this time.
